goal: Restore test output and failure diagnostics for Qt unit tests in Windows CI
reviewability: Two-line change to CI environment variables with no conflicts

categories.name: build
why: P3 because it restores missing test logs for Qt unit tests in Windows CI

categories.name: tests

result.summary: Sets `QT_ASSUME_STDERR_HAS_CONSOLE=1` in the Windows GitHub Actions runner scripts `.github/ci-windows.py` and `.github/ci-windows-cross.py`. This ensures Qt emits unit test output to stderr even when running in an environment without an attached console.
result.problem: In GitHub Actions runners on Windows, Qt detects no console is attached and suppresses stderr logging in `test_bitcoin-qt.exe`, hiding test execution logs and failure messages from developers.

categories.evidence: Modifies GitHub Actions CI scripts (.github/ci-windows*.py) for Windows CI jobs.
categories.rationale: Improves CI diagnostics by restoring lost test failure output on Windows runners. As the author explains, 'there is no console attached, so Qt's stderrHasConsoleAttached() returns false and the entire test report is lost'.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Labeled Tests; directly affects the reporting and observability of the Qt unit test runner.
categories.rationale: Ensures unit test failure logs from `test_bitcoin-qt.exe` are visible when run in CI, allowing test failures to be diagnosed.

result.card: This PR sets QT_ASSUME_STDERR_HAS_CONSOLE=1 in Windows CI scripts so that test_bitcoin-qt.exe prints test reports instead of silencing output. In GitHub Actions, Qt's console detection currently fails and drops the entire test log. The change is a minimal two-line fix to CI environment variables. It has had no reviewer activity since opening.
